title: Back to the start
goal: I can find the start of a story when I know the end. I go backwards and undo each step.

learn.intro: In a mystery number story, we know the end. We undo each step.

example.problem: Ravi has some stickers. He gets 5 more, then gives 3 to Mei. Now he has 12 stickers. How many stickers did Ravi begin with?

howto.title: How to work backwards
steps: Find the end number. This is the number you know.
Undo the last step first. Add becomes take away. Take away becomes add.
Keep going back until you reach the start.

try.text: Mei buys 6 beads. Now she has 15 beads. How many beads did she begin with? {b} beads
try.explanation: She added 6, so undo it by taking away 6: 15 - 6 = 9. Check: 9 + 6 = 15.

items.text: A cup hides some counters. 5 more counters go in. Now there are 13 counters. How many counters were in the cup at first? {b} counters
items.explanation: Adding 5 made 13. Undo it by taking away 5: 13 - 5 = 8. Check: 8 + 5 = 13.

items.text: Mei picks a secret number. Fill in her secret number each time.

parts.label: a
parts.text: She adds 8 and gets 13. Her number is {b}.

parts.label: b
parts.text: She adds 7 and gets 15. Her number is {b}.

parts.label: c
parts.text: She takes away 5 and gets 9. Her number is {b}.

parts.label: d
parts.text: She takes away 6 and gets 12. Her number is {b}.

items.explanation: Undo the step. Undo add with take away: 13 - 8 = 5 and 15 - 7 = 8. Undo take away with add: 9 + 5 = 14 and 12 + 6 = 18.

items.text: Aisha has some biscuits. She eats 4 biscuits. 9 biscuits are left. How many biscuits did she have at first? {b} biscuits
items.explanation: She took away 4 and 9 are left. Undo it by adding 4: 9 + 4 = 13. Check: 13 - 4 = 9.

items.text: Write the number in the empty box. Go backwards along the arrow.
items.explanation: The arrow adds 9 to reach 17. Go backwards: 17 - 9 = 8. Check: 8 + 9 = 17.

items.text: Siti has some pencils. She gives 3 to Ali, then buys 8 more. Now she has 14 pencils. How many pencils did she begin with? {b} pencils
items.explanation: Start at the end: 14. Undo buying 8: 14 - 8 = 6. Undo giving 3 away: 6 + 3 = 9. Check: 9 - 3 = 6 and 6 + 8 = 14.

items.text: Write the 2 missing numbers in the empty boxes. Go backwards.

answer.text: 18 in the middle, 11 at the start

items.explanation: The last arrow takes away 3 to reach 15. Undo it: 15 + 3 = 18. The first arrow adds 7 to reach 18. Undo it: 18 - 7 = 11.

items.text: This machine always adds the same number. Look at the table.

parts.label: a
parts.text: The machine adds {b}.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Write the 3 missing numbers in the table.

items.explanation: IN 6 gives OUT 10, so the machine adds 4. IN 9 gives 9 + 4 = 13. OUT 17 came from IN 17 - 4 = 13. IN 15 gives 15 + 4 = 19.

items.text: Fill in the missing number. Go backwards.
items.explanation: Part (a): 15 - 6 = 9. Part (b): 9 + 4 = 13. Part (c): the number taken away is 18 - 11 = 7.

items.text: A lift goes down 4 floors. Then it goes up 6 floors. It stops on floor 11. On which floor did the lift begin? Floor {b}
items.explanation: Undo going up 6: 11 - 6 = 5. Undo going down 4: 5 + 4 = 9. Check: 9 - 4 = 5 and 5 + 6 = 11.

items.text: Kumar is 6th in a queue. There are 2 children behind him. How many children are there in the queue altogether? {b} children
items.explanation: Kumar is the 6th child, so 6 children are at the front, counting him. 2 more are behind him: 6 + 2 = 8 children.

items.text: Aisha stands 5th from the front in a line of 12 children. How many children are behind her? {b} children
items.explanation: 5 children are at the front, and Aisha is the 5th. The rest are behind her: 12 - 5 = 7.

items.text: Think about more and fewer.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Ali has 15 stickers. He has 6 more than Siti. Siti has {b} stickers.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Ben has 9 sweets. He has 6 fewer than Jenny. Jenny has {b} sweets.

items.explanation: (a) Ali has more, so Siti has fewer: 15 - 6 = 9. (b) Ben has fewer, so Jenny has more: 9 + 6 = 15.

items.text: Check going forwards. Circle True or False.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Start at 9. Add 4. Take away 6. You get 7.   {circ:True|False}

parts.label: b
parts.text: Start at 12. Take away 5. Add 3. You get 9.   {circ:True|False}

parts.label: c
parts.text: Start at 8. Add 7. Take away 4. You get 11.   {circ:True|False}

items.text: Kumar picks a number and adds 6. He gets 15. Is his number 21?

parts.label: a
parts.text: Circle Yes or No.   {circ:Yes|No}

parts.label: b
parts.text: His number is {b}.

items.explanation: To undo add 6, take away 6: 15 - 6 = 9. If his number were 21, adding 6 would give 27, not 15. So 21 is not his number.

items.text: Mei has some stickers. She gives 5 to Ali, gets 8 from Ben and gives 4 to Siti. Now she has 13 stickers.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Before she gave 4 to Siti, she had {b} stickers.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Before Ben gave her 8, she had {b} stickers.

parts.label: c
parts.text: At first Mei had {b} stickers.

items.hint: Go back one step at a time. Which step is the last?
items.explanation: Undo the last step first: 13 + 4 = 17. Undo getting 8: 17 - 8 = 9. Undo giving 5 to Ali: 9 + 5 = 14. Check: 14 - 5 = 9, 9 + 8 = 17, 17 - 4 = 13.

items.text: A machine adds 9 and then takes away 4. A one-step machine does the same job.

parts.label: a
parts.text: The one-step machine adds {b}.

parts.label: b
parts.text: IN 11 gives OUT {b}.

parts.label: c
parts.text: OUT 30 comes from IN {b}.

items.hint: Try IN 10. What is OUT? How far is it from 10?
items.explanation: Adding 9 and taking away 4 is the same as adding 5. IN 11 gives 11 + 5 = 16. For OUT 30, go backwards: 30 - 5 = 25.

items.text: Ali gives 4 stickers to Mei. Now each child has 10 stickers.

parts.label: a
parts.text: Ali had {b} stickers at first.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Mei had {b} stickers at first.

items.hint: Who gets 4 back? Who gives 4 back?
items.explanation: Ali gave 4 away, so he had 4 more at first: 10 + 4 = 14. Mei got 4, so she had 4 fewer at first: 10 - 4 = 6. Check: 14 - 4 = 10 and 6 + 4 = 10.

items.text: Aisha picks a number and adds it to itself. This is a double. Find each number.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Double it, then add 4. She gets 18. Her number is {b}.

parts.label: c
parts.text: Double it, then take away 5. She gets 11. Her number is {b}.

items.hint: Undo the last step first. Then which double is that?
items.explanation: (b) Undo add 4: 18 - 4 = 14. 7 + 7 = 14, so her number is 7. (c) Undo take away 5: 11 + 5 = 16. 8 + 8 = 16, so her number is 8.

items.text: Does the order of the steps matter?

parts.label: a
parts.text: Start at 12. Add 6, then take away 9. You get {b}.

parts.label: b
parts.text: Start at 12. Take away 9, then add 6. You get {b}.

parts.label: c
parts.text: Start at 5. Add 6, then take away 9. You get {b}.

parts.label: d
parts.text: Start at 5. Can you take away 9 first? {circ:Yes|No}

items.hint: Do each one a step at a time. Check part (d) with care.
items.explanation: 12 + 6 = 18, 18 - 9 = 9, and 12 - 9 = 3, 3 + 6 = 9. Both give 9. 5 + 6 = 11, 11 - 9 = 2. But you cannot take 9 from 5, so for 5 the order does matter.

items.text: A frog is at the bottom of a well with 12 steps. Each day it climbs 4 steps. Each night it slides back 2 steps. On which day does the frog get out?

parts.label: a
parts.text: The frog gets out on day {b}.

items.hint: Where is the frog after day 1? And after night 1?
items.explanation: Start at the top and go backwards. On the last day the frog starts on step 8 and climbs 4 to reach 12. It starts each day 2 steps higher: day 1 starts on 0, day 2 on 2, day 3 on 4, day 4 on 6, day 5 on 8. So it gets out on day 5.

items.text: Wei picks a number and adds 7. He gets 16. His number is {b}.
items.explanation: Undo add 7: 16 - 7 = 9.

items.text: Lily gives away 5 stickers, then gets 9. Now she has 17. At first she had {b} stickers.
items.explanation: Undo getting 9: 17 - 9 = 8. Undo giving away 5: 8 + 5 = 13.

items.text: A machine takes away 6. OUT is 9. IN is {b}.
items.explanation: Undo take away 6 with add 6: 9 + 6 = 15.

items.text: Ali picks a number and takes away 7. He gets 8. His number is {b}.
items.explanation: Undo take away 7 with add 7: 8 + 7 = 15. Check: 15 - 7 = 8.
